name: April
objective: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.
strategy:
Cloud Nine — 9 Years of Physique 57.

Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Upgrade: Cloud Nine Limited Edition (“Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.”). Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. At ₹16,500/month it sits between 6M list (₹18,953/month) and an annual at 20% (₹14,630/month), so it upsells 1M/3M members without cannibalising annuals. Effective discount vs 10× 1M list: 18.5% Mumbai, 17.8% Bengaluru.

Renewal: Club Nine: The Founders' Table (“Nine numbered seats. Founder perks for a year.”). Kwality sold 34 annuals on a flat 25% code in 2026 (₹9.7L given away). Numbered scarcity, a public counter and perks deliver ≈25% value at a 20% cash discount.

Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Lapsed: Where Are They Now? (“You joined us in {year}. A lot has changed (we got prettier).”). A personal anniversary in the brand's anniversary month is a stronger trigger than a generic code. Bandra's reactivation pool is the largest; the reunion is a public attendance moment.

Referral: Plus One, Plus Nine (“Bring a friend, get 9 days. Bring three, get a month.”). Referral is the best converting source in every studio (22.6–76.1%) and Kwality's third-largest lead source. The reward is only paid when a new client buys, so it is acquisition spend, not discount.
notes: Build: 129 new buyers × ₹11,150 first-60-day spend = ₹14.4L; 141 renewals × ₹23,384 = ₹33.0L; 63 winbacks = ₹7.2L; privates/retail/drop-ins ₹5.4L. Offers carry ₹45.1L (75% of target); the rest is business-as-usual. Funnel uses measured rates (lead→trial 51% CRM status, trial→member 26.9%) — not invented lifts.
